services.name: School Programs
services.desc: Get involved, join the fun and make a difference!Saturday September 18stfrom 8am-10am This new program has been designed to teach about the importance of protecting and preserving our environment through the understanding and exploring of current environmental issues: sea level rise, climate change, ocean acidification and the need for recycling. Learn about marine invertebrate characteristics, adaptations, functions, development, conservation and more through live marine invertebrates in our interactive touch tank (field trips only). The program also includes a tour of our world class shell collection as well as a shark feeding presentation. Students get a chance to see and hold mermaids

services.name: Hands on Exhibits
services.desc: Get involved, join the fun and make a difference!Saturday September 18stfrom 8am-10am Learn a multitude of fun and interesting facts about the ocean's top predators at Sandoway's 15,000-gallon saltwater pool filled with Nurse Sharks and reef fish. All ages can touch stingrays in our stingray touch tank. Have you ever touched a sea star or urchin? Now you can at Sandoway's invertebrate touch tank. Visitors will get the chance to touch Urchins, Sea Stars, and Sea Cucumbers. Learn why they are important to our oceans and how we can protect them! services.name: Birthday Party
services.desc: Get involved, join the fun and make a difference!Saturday September 18stfrom 8am-10am Parties are approximately 2 1/2 hours long and cost a flat rate of $300. Birthday parties are only scheduled when we are closed to the public which is Sunday mornings from 9am-12pm as well as weekdays (Tues.-Fri. 9am-12pm). No more than a total of 25 individuals are allowed in the party room (this includes adults and children). Groups are able to select up to four animal activities for their party (see below) and every party gets a shark feeding!
